item.description:
A fix for signing in to HQBase 1.4.2 and later.

Fixed

  • Signing in no longer fails with "The following scopes are invalid: signatures:manage". Herald registered itself with your server before it started asking for permission to manage signatures, then kept reusing that registration, which the server refuses for the new permission. Herald now registers again whenever it needs permissions its saved registration doesn't cover, and a refused sign-in clears the old registration so the next attempt succeeds.
  • Sign-in error messages show spaces instead of + signs.
